description:
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
During your extra turn, cast Humility by paying {2}{W}{W}.
Declare Medomai as an attacker, as it does not have its restriction due to Humility.
Holding priority, cast Capsize with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U}, returning Humility and Capsize to your hand.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.name: Medomai the Ageless
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent
